**Daily multi-stylist sweep — end-of-day (2026-10-30)**

- **Fire time:** 2026-10-30 18:30 ET (18:32 ET window check, weekday, in-window). **Screens run on:** shibui session **2026-10-29** (shibui is T+1; its latest bar at fire time was 10-29).
- **EOD overlay:** settled **2026-10-30** 16:00 ET closes from TradingView, cross-checked against CBOE and Nasdaq.

- Friday was an AI-led unwind:
- the S&P 500 lost 1.82% to 7,580.07, the Nasdaq-100 fell 3.46%, and VIX jumped 12.9% to 19.42 after Alphabet's Thursday miss and then Amazon's and Intel's weak results overnight.
- The important structural detail is that this was **not** a broad de-rating —
- SPY fell 1.77% while equal-weight RSP fell only 0.79%, and 58.0% of the 1,001-name large-cap universe still closed above its 20-DMA.
- Money left the AI complex and piled into energy, staples, utilities and health care.

- That backdrop is what makes this sweep's numbers worth reading:
- the screens were computed on the **10-29** bar, so the 10-30 column below is the scoreboard for what the setup actually did.
- Several of the best names were still flat or down on the day the screen saw them, and moved the next session.

**Regime**

- `size_cut_pct` **0**, `uncertainty` **false**, `late_cycle` **false**.
- Breadth of 58.0% is above the 40% threshold, so the mechanical size cut does not trigger even though 2 of 5 index ETFs sit below their 20-DMA.
- The VIX/VIX3M ratio of 0.93 says the term structure has **not** inverted into stress after a 13% one-day jump in the front end —
- the shock was absorbed by duration, not by crash hedging. Full detail in `breadth.md`; the payload is in `_regime.json`.

**Method and caveats**

- **T+1 screens.** shibui's latest bar at fire time was 2026-10-29, so every stylist screen and every
flag is computed on 10-29 data. The 10-30 column is the settled close applied afterwards.

- **CANSLIM is rebuilt on shibui.** TradingView's `earnings_growth_quarterly_yoy` and
- `sales_growth_quarterly_yoy` are null for every US name, so the Jeff Sun screen runs on shibui's quarterly `eps_growth_yoy` / `revenue_growth_yoy` (decimal fractions) with the RSI, SMA and market-cap gates from the spec.

- **The skill's published sweep SQL has five defects** (a missing CTE comma, a mismatched LAG alias
- family, mismatched UNION arity, a lookback shorter than the 252-day LAG it needs, and column names inherited from the first branch).
- All were repaired before running; the Qullamaggi relative-strength book returns 60 names instead of the empty result the published SQL produces.

- **The peoplewish book is truncated at 200 rows** by the shibui server's row cap. The sort is by
14-day velocity descending, so the head of the book is intact but the tail is not visible.

- **The theme funnel selects leaders, not sectors.** The top-3 themes (XLE, XLV, IBB) map to two GICS
sectors, and only the top-5 names by 3-month relative strength inside each sector that had already cleared another stylist screen are tagged.

- **Sub-procedures not run.** The 3:55 PM reversal-bullish scan (window 15:30-16:00 ET), the 09:00 ET
pre-market gapper and the 09:45-11:15 ET intraday RVOL re-rank are all window-bound and outside an 18:30 ET fire. The Sunday IPO and high-short-float refreshes do not apply to a Friday.

- **No tier-2 fallback was used or available.** Finviz is Cloudflare-403 from this egress and Yahoo
JSON is rate-limited, so the market-cap floor was enforced strictly against shibui's own valuation table.

**Source health**

- **Source**: shibui-finance (MCP-over-HTTP bridge) · **Endpoint / query**: `stock_data_query`, 12 calls · **Status**: ok
- **Result**: All returned data; one Binder Error on the first ATR attempt was re-issued corrected against the same source
- **Source**: shibui breadth aggregate · **Endpoint / query**: `market_cap > 10B` join, 2026-10-29 · **Status**: ok · **Result**: 913 names, 69.33% above 20-DMA
- **Source**: TradingView scanner · **Endpoint / query**: `POST scanner.tradingview.com/america/scan`, 6 calls · **Status**: ok
- **Result**: No rate limiting; `change` is in percent units; `type=stock` drops every ETF so ETF screens omit the type filter
- **Source**: CBOE delayed quotes · **Endpoint / query**: `cdn.cboe.com/api/global/delayed_quotes/quotes/_VIX.json` (+15 symbols) · **Status**: ok
- **Result**: `close` is the 16:00 settle after hours; `current_price` is the after-hours print and was not used
- **Source**: CBOE daily history CSV · **Endpoint / query**: `VIX_History.csv`, `VIX3M_History.csv` · **Status**: partial
- **Result**: VIX3M rolled to 10/30; VIX_History.csv still ends 10/29, so the 10-30 VIX came from the delayed-quote CDN
- **Source**: Nasdaq quote API · **Endpoint / query**: `api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/{SYM}/info` · **Status**: ok · **Result**: `secondaryData` carries the official close (INTC 65.76 -28.58%, CDNA 87.41 +22.22% — both match TradingView exactly)
- **Source**: web_search · **Endpoint / query**: catalyst research, 8 queries · **Status**: ok · **Result**: Market wrap and per-name catalysts confirmed against company releases and two independent price feeds
